entities.summary:
Alexander Knaifel was a Soviet and Russian composer, often described as one of the most prominent Russian composers of his generation. His work spans early experimental compositions associated with Soviet avantgarde and later turns towards a contemplative, spiritually oriented aesthetic influenced by Orthodox Christianity. Knaifel’s music is characterized by a distinctive use of silence, sparse
musical material, and unconventional approaches to text and sound. Alexander Knaifel was a composers & musicians from Tashkent (1943-11-28, Tashkent–2024-06-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
